limitations: Spotify apps start in Development Mode limited to 25 pre-approved user accounts. Production quota requires an extension request review.

assumptions: Building web app with Authorization Code Flow with PKCE

externalWait.publishedRange: Instant for Development Mode (<=25 users); 3–7 business days for Quota Extension to production

prerequisites.text: Spotify free or premium developer account

steps.title: Register App in Spotify Developer Dashboard
steps.instructions: Navigate to `https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard` and log in. Click 'Create an App'. Specify 'App Name', 'App Description', and select which APIs you intend to use (Web API). Accept the Spotify Developer Terms of Service.
steps.completionCheck: Spotify Dashboard displays new app overview with Client ID.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs in App Settings
steps.instructions: In your app overview, click 'Settings' in the top right. Under 'Redirect URIs', enter your callback URL (e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth/callback/spotify`). Ensure no trailing slashes or query parameters exist unless matching your server endpoint exactly. Click 'Add' then 'Save'.
steps.completionCheck: Redirect URI appears in the whitelist table.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Code with PKCE
steps.instructions: Generate a high-entropy cryptographic `code_verifier` (43–128 chars) and compute `code_challenge = BASE64URL-ENCODE(SHA256(code_verifier))`. Direct the user to `https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={ENCODED_REDIRECT}&code_challenge_method=S256&code_challenge={CODE_CHALLENGE}&scope=user-read-private%20user-read-email`.
steps.completionCheck: User is redirected back to callback URL with authorization code.

steps.title: Exchange Code for Access & Refresh Tokens
steps.instructions: POST to `https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token` with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and body parameters: `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code={AUTH_CODE}`, `redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}`, `client_id={CLIENT_ID}`, and `code_verifier={CODE_VERIFIER}`. Spotify returns `access_token` (expires in 1 hr) and a long-lived `refresh_token`.
steps.completionCheck: HTTP 200 response contains valid access_token and refresh_token.

claims.text: Spotify apps are created at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard and assigned a Client ID.
Spotify requires explicit whitelisting of exact redirect URIs in App Settings before authorization can proceed.
Spotify supports Authorization Code Flow with PKCE using SHA-256 code challenge.
Tokens are obtained by POSTing code and code_verifier to https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token.
